item.title: Iran’s president condemns environmental impact of war in Middle East
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has decried the ecological damage caused by conflict in the Middle East

item.title: Division in Lebanon over Hezbollah’s confiscated explosives
item.description: Hezbollah said explosives were to be used against Israel but political figures and some analysts fear assassinations.

item.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
item.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

item.title: Albanian protests turn violent: What we know
item.description: Albania's capital Tirana has seen months of protests from an anti-government "Flamingo" movement, but what started on Tuesday this week was on a different scale.

item.title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke to Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of a conference.

item.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
item.description: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.

item.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
item.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

item.title: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings still have no public outcome, BBC Verify finds
item.description: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.

item.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
item.description: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in West Bank during olive harvest
item.description: Israeli settlers were seen attacking Palestinian farmers and setting fire to olive trees in the West Bank.
